reasoning_checks: Information measurability is separated from a raw return forecast, a pricing restriction and an executable net profit. The conditional-SDF example establishes compatibility, not a proof of informational efficiency.

Physical probabilities remain separate from state prices. E[mG|I]=1 and E[m]=1/Rf imply the stated conditional risk-premium identity; measurable positions can be pulled outside the conditional expectation.
Regime expected returns 1/49 and 3/47 coexist with positive state prices. The constant-quiet benchmark produces 100/2303 stress residual because it omits changing covariance compensation.
Hindsight long/short selection is explicitly nonmeasurable at trade time. Its nonnegative payoff has positive state-price value91/5 and is not obtained by a zero-cost admissible strategy.

The event model excludes execution at a pre-release price. Ask/bid, both transaction fees and information cost enter total entry cash and final cash once. The example remains a realized ledger, not expected alpha.

One-sided fair-sign tails are derived by counting sequences. Family equality assumes independent candidate tests; Bonferroni needs valid individual tests but not their independence. Selection depends only on training, and all candidates are retained.

The behavioral investor uses a mistaken likelihood, not an unexplained label. Risk preferences remain fixed in the counterfactual while both subjective mean and variance change. Concavity proves each demand optimum.

Behavioral holdings, traded cash and statewise terminal resources clear. A correct-belief counterfactual is not uniquely observable fundamental value. Positive supporting state prices and a possible short loss prevent a false sure-arbitrage claim.

Information value compares optimal contingent versus constant actions before observing the signal. A fixed capped quote is a supplied contract, not a competitive market model. Public revelation can eliminate the private incremental gain.

The funding example changes trading rights: short proceeds are unavailable, the long cannot collateralize, and margin is cash based on the current short value. Entry116 and survival134 exclude the fee only because the fee is due after closing cash release.

At wealth125, marked equity95 does not supply the18 cash call; free cash is9. Full forced closing produces93 after fee versus133 on convergence. At134 the same call is met and final wealth142 reconciles independent of the common terminal payoff.

Integer entry capacity and stress-surviving capacity differ. With250 CU two pairs enter but fail the call, while one pair survives; the no-pair case and entry-infeasible requests are treated honestly.

Exercise8 gives explicit five-domain evaluation criteria and a concrete possible behavioral falsifier rather than claiming a unique empirical interpretation. No historical anomaly or current-return estimate is imported from the methodological sources.

resolved_findings.finding: Coordinator required explicit timing for the2-CU fee because entry116 and stress134 exclude it.
resolved_findings.resolution: Chapter, input convention and README put all pair fees after closing cash release; no entry/interim fee. Long is unpledgeable, short proceeds locked and current-value cash margin explicit. Checker reconstructs each cash date.

resolved_findings.finding: Draft exercise4 wording could suggest twenty independent tests were necessarily obtainable from one identical eight-outcome sequence.
resolved_findings.resolution: Prompt now states twenty rules each evaluated on eight new trades, with independent tests explicitly assumed under the null. Dependence-robust bound and limits remain separate.

limitations: Author and automated review are not independent human certification; coordinator acceptance remains pending.
All data and contracts are invented and conditional. No expected-return model, belief error, trading right, borrow availability or funding commitment is authenticated for a real investment.
The small fair-sign test does not replace dependence-aware empirical inference, and the belief/funding cases do not solve general endogenous-information or intermediary equilibrium.
Whole-library acceptance, visual/mobile/keyboard/print QA and publishing remain coordinator tasks; none is claimed here.
